en: Black‑and‑white rural scene showing an unpaved country road lined with irregular stone posts and wooden fences, leading toward a cluster of small buildings in the distance. Farmhouses and fields lie on both sides of the road, with a forested area and a partly cloudy sky in the background. Several people are gathered further down the road. In the upper left corner appears the printed caption "Parti fra Midtskogen".
